title: nephrodium siambonense
intro: Nephrodium siambonense, commonly known as Siam fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Matoniaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The health benefits of Nephrodium siambonense include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
